description: Sample community messages for the two-stage workflow. `representative_category` is what a reasonable classifier is expected to pick; tests validate output shapes and contracts, never exact model prose.

expected_result_shape.summary: non-empty string, at most 400 characters, one sentence

messages.text: There has been a water leak near the entrance since this morning. Can someone inspect it?
Hay una fuga de agua cerca de la entrada desde esta mañana. ¿Alguien puede revisarla?
The people in apartment 4B have been playing loud music past midnight every night this week. Could someone please talk to them?
